title: Chapter 530 - 530 Off-Stream; Pay For The Bill?!
content:
Chapter 530 - 530 Off-Stream; Pay For The Bill?!

Chapter 530 - 530 Off-Stream; Pay for the Bill?!

530 Off-Stream; Pay for the Bill?!

In the live broadcast room, countless comments continued to appear.

Little Wen Zi: [Haiyan, you have to remember that you are a girl! You’re a girl!]

Misery of Lovesvesickness: [Haiyan actually used her hands to hold the steak and chomp on it. Her face is full of grease, and it even dripped onto her clothes… It’s over, it’s over. Her image as a goddess is completely shattered.]

Carefree Life: [No way, no way. There are actually people who treat Haiyan as a goddess?]

Incarnation of Man and Demon: [The goddess is a goddess, but she’s a psychopath!]

….

In the live broadcast, Li Haiyan was completely immersed in the delicious steak and could not extricate herself.

In fact… she kept looking for opportunities to quietly throw it into the trash can.

Finally, the entire steak was eaten clean.

She even looked as if she had not had enough and licked her fingers hard.

At this moment, the 10-pound lobster was served.

When she saw the arm-long lobster, Li Haiyan’s eyes and mouth widened as she shouted, “Wow! It’s so big!

“Do you see that? Such a big lobster!

“It’s almost half my height!

“Heavens!”

Li Haiyan could not help but exclaim. Then, she hurriedly picked up the lobster’s pincers and took a big bite.

“I’m so satisfied, so satisfied!

“Delicious!”

As she ate, she shouted excitedly as if she was completely immersed in the delicious food.

She kept throwing the meat into the trash can where the camera could not see.

These delicacies were indeed delicious.

However, she was already full when she ate 18 Delicacies.

How could she still eat?

When Li Haiyan burped, the lobster on the table had been completely devoured by her.

She rubbed her stomach and said, “I’m full! Today’s trip to Time Restaurant is over!

“See you next time, everyone.

“I’m too full. I have to rest now.”

Mo Wentian: [Haiyan, why don’t you look at how much you’ve eaten?]

Wushuang: [Every time I watch Haiyan’s live broadcast, I feel like I can eat two big bowls of rice.]

The World Is Mine: [Goodbye, Haiyan.]

Unique: [Let’s sponsor her a little so that Haiyan can afford it. I don’t want to see her washing dishes during the next live broadcast.]

…

Thus, the live broadcast room received another wave of gifts.

Li Haiyan was full of smiles and could not stop thanking the viewers.

After a while, she turned off the live-stream.

The smile on Li Haiyan’s face instantly disappeared, as if she had suddenly become a different person.

At this moment, the oval-faced waitress slowly walked over with a few bags of snacks.

She said with a smile, “Hi, these are some snacks prepared by our restaurant. I hope you like them.”

Li Haiyan glanced at the snacks and said indifferently, “Alright then.”

She took the snacks and got ready to walk out.

The oval-faced waitress was slightly stunned. She saw that Li Haiyan was about to walk out of the restaurant.

She could not help but say, “Uhh… Miss, you seem to have forgotten to pay the bill.”

“The bill?” Li Haiyan dragged out her voice and called out.

It was as if she had heard the funniest joke in the world.

“You want me to pay?” Li Haiyan said in disbelief.

The oval-faced waitress was at a loss.

Since she had eaten here, she had to pay the bill. Was this not within reason?

Moreover, her meal cost a lot.

Thinking of this, she nodded lightly.

Seeing this…

Li Haiyan was furious and started cursing.

“You’re blind!

“Do you know who I am? I’m the food streamer, Haiyan! I have more than three million fans on Douyin!

“I ate in your restaurant and live-streamed it. How much traffic will this bring you?

“I didn’t even ask you for money. How dare you ask me to pay?”

The oval-faced waitress did not expect the other party to suddenly curse. She did not know what to do.

She stammered, “But… Time Restaurant never invited you over…”

“You didn’t invite me? Alright! Do you mean to say that I’m taking advantage of your restaurant’s reputation?!

“Call your manager over!”

Li Haiyan became even angrier. Her voice became very ear-piercing, and her entire face became a little ferocious.

Not far away, the general manager in a suit hurriedly walked over when he heard the voices.

Even though he did not know what had happened, he still used a very friendly attitude toward Li Haiyan and said, “Miss, I’m sorry for giving you a bad experience. May I ask what happened? I’m Zhang Shiwei, the manager of Time Restaurant.”

After all, in the service industry, the customer was always right.

At this moment, there were still many diners in the restaurant. If this left a bad impression on others, it would definitely be a very bad thing.

When Li Haiyan heard that Zhang Shiwei was the manager, she only glanced at him from the corner of her eye.

“Manager? You’re here just in time. Do you know that I’m a food streamer with more than three million fans? My name is Haiyan!

“I came to visit the restaurant today and broadcasted the entire process to my audience. Do you know how much traffic this will bring to your restaurant?

“However, your waitress actually wants me to pay!

“Don’t you think it’s ridiculous?”

Zhang Shiwei first smiled apologetically. “I see. I’m sorry…”

Then, he whispered to the waitress, “What food did she order?”

The oval-faced waitress said, “18 Delicacies, M5 steak, soup, and a 10-pound lobster.”

Zhang Shiwei frowned slightly.

If they were ordinary dishes, he would just let it go.

However, these dishes were all expensive.

The 10-pound lobster cost tens of thousands.

Zhang Shiwei stole a glance at Li Haiyan. She looked like she would not give up. He was struggling in his heart.

Why not just forget about it?

After all, she was a big streamer with three million fans and could not be easily offended.

Thinking of this, Zhang Shiwei finally gritted his teeth and said, “Miss Haiyan, I’m sorry. This waiter is a newcomer and doesn’t know the rules…”

However, Li Haiyan continued, “Do you think just saying that she doesn’t know the rules is enough? If the free had been made free earlier, it would’ve been fine!

“But she made me unhappy!

“Now, everything has to be settled according to the normal rules!

“My normal visit to a restaurant costs 200,000 yuan! You just need to pay me 200,000 yuan.”

Zhang Shiwei’s expression changed slightly.

He could still think of a way to exempt the cost of ingredients that amounted to tens of thousands.

However, the 200,000 yuan visit fee was definitely not something he could decide directly.
